items.label: Synopsys Q3 FY2026 (08-26-2026)
items.signal_prefix: EDA / MULTI-DIE: AMD's newly launched Instinct MI455X GPU

set.signal: EDA / MULTI-DIE: AMD's newly launched Instinct MI455X GPU was delivered using Synopsys 3DIC COMPILER, described as the industry's only exploration-to-sign-off platform for multi-die and advanced-package co-design. Asked about the 2024 Investor Day outlook that ~30% of EDA software demand might come from MULTI-DIE, the CEO said 'that forecast has accelerated' ('The 30% back then was a figure we thought was a stretch, but it absolutely accelerated'), driven by advanced packaging and 3DIC architectures. MULTIPHYSICS FUSION LAUNCHED in Q3 — the first joint Synopsys+Ansys product and the industry's only solution with thermal analysis fully integrated into the chip design flow; NVIDIA, Cisco, MediaTek and Samsung Foundry have validated up to 10x FASTER DESIGN CLOSURE and 3x faster runtime (3x faster SPICE-accurate multiphysics timing). Management expects these add-on capabilities to begin contributing to EDA growth in 2027 (CEO: 'FY 2026, we will not have much contribution in the joint solution'); $400M synergy commitment in year four reaffirmed. Hardware-assisted verification: 12 NEW + 66 REPEAT customer wins in the quarter and a record hardware revenue year.

items.reason: The 30% figure was put by the analyst and confirmed by the CEO, so it is attributed to the CEO; the CEO said FY2026 will not have MUCH contribution, not none (hedge restored).
items.evidence: As we've said from the beginning, FY 2026, we will not have much contribution in the joint solution. It was a year of execution, delivering to these products.

items.signal_prefix: DESIGN IP — the custom-silicon tell. Won MORE THAN 95%

set.signal: DESIGN IP — the custom-silicon tell. Won MORE THAN 95% of PCIe 7.0 opportunities, including a subsystem win at a marquee enterprise storage customer. DIE-TO-DIE business ON PACE TO DOUBLE YEAR-OVER-YEAR with 100+ cumulative design wins. LPDDR6: 25 design wins year to date, silicon proven across multiple nodes and foundries. USB IP crossed $2B in lifetime bookings. Automotive design-win rate 90%+ for three consecutive quarters as ADAS platforms refresh onto 5nm and 3nm. FACTORY TWO (new): customized IP for hyperscalers, ASIC vendors, foundries and classic semis, moving the model from licensing alone to LICENSING PLUS ROYALTIES; 'active discussions with multiple Factory Two customers.' Design-start read-through: NON-AI design starts have STABILIZED over the last two quarters (no longer declining) while AI design starts continue to ACCELERATE. Long-term IP growth guide remains mid-teens pending the September Investor Day.

items.reason: The call states only the >95% PCIe 7.0 win rate; the Q2 comparison is not in this source.

items.label: Synopsys Q3 FY2026 (08-26-2026)
items.signal_prefix: AGENTIC AI: at the Design Automation Conference WITH NVIDIA, Synopsys showed

set.signal: AGENTIC AI: at the Design Automation Conference WITH NVIDIA, Synopsys showcased a fully autonomous long-running design-verification agent orchestrating the entire verification cycle — up to 50x FASTER TIME TO VALIDATED RTL with 20% additional coverage improvement (CEO: 'a demonstration with NVIDIA on an autonomous long-running agent capability'). WITH MICROSOFT AND AMD, Synopsys introduced what the CEO called 'the first autonomous EDA workflows on Microsoft Discovery', automating debug, implementation and design closure — per the CEO 'a demonstration of a full autonomous EDA workflow'; early engagements show up to 40% REDUCTION IN DEBUG CYCLE TIME. More than 30 ACTIVE customer engagements on the agentic platform. Key monetization tell: as agents take on engineering work they ORCHESTRATE THE UNDERLYING EDA TOOLS AT A SIGNIFICANTLY HIGHER RATE, so customers need MORE LICENSES; Synopsys is defining subscription-of-agents plus CONSUMPTION-based models with customers, to be detailed at the Investor Day. CEO position on AI-native chip design as a disruption risk: autonomous workflows require accuracy and determinism, so sign-off ground-truth physics makes AI a demand driver rather than a threat.

items.reason: Skill 2.4: both agentic items were demonstrations (CEO's word) and 'first' is the company's claim, so both are attributed as such; the Investor Day date (an event schedule) is dropped.
items.evidence: The two demos we've done, and thank you for mentioning the Microsoft AMD, which was a demonstration of a full autonomous EDA workflow on the Microsoft Discovery.
